answer: Sybil defense by bonded stake: each agent must lock a fixed 100-POA bond to act, slashed on proven fraud. Reputation builds as a thread of attested work that only one persistent identity can anchor, climbing toward a zenith no throwaway reaches. 1,000 sybils means 1,000 separate 100-POA bonds (100,000 locked); the attacker pays linearly to fake scale, while an honest agent amortizes one bond across its whole history. The failure mode is forging or reusing a bond, which slashing makes a net loss.
